title: SkillState
description: Latent ability for one (developer, skill) pair, held in LOGIT space so the Kalman update is exact on an unbounded variable. This record is a DERIVED CACHE, never a source of truth: it is recomputable at any timestamp by folding the immutable evidence log in occurred_at order. Deleting every SkillState must lose nothing.

subject_ref.description: Pseudonymous stable reference. Never a name or email.

skill_id.description: Canonical ontology id, ESCO-seeded. An event naming an unknown id is quarantined, never dropped.

mu.description: Mean of the latent ability in logit space. Display value is sigmoid(mu).

var.description: Variance in logit space. Grows with elapsed time: var(t) = var(tau) + lambda_s * dt.

as_of.description: Timestamp this state was decayed to. A state is only meaningful together with its as_of.

tier.description: Volatility class, fixing lambda_s and h_s. Three tiers, not a continuum, so the sweep stays exhaustive.

evidence_count.description: Direct evidence events folded into this state. Zero means the state is the prior, and the query API must say so rather than reporting a score as though it were measured.

newest_evidence_at.description: occurred_at of the most recent direct evidence. Drives days_since_newest_evidence in the explain response.

parameter_version.description: Version of m6-parameters.yaml this state was computed under. A parameter change invalidates every state; the version is how you know.

event_ids.description: Every event folded in, in order. Makes the score decomposable and any single source ablatable.

propagated.description: Present only on read-time propagated states. Absent on direct-evidence states, which are the only ones propagation may source from.

gamma.description: Damping for this edge TYPE, never for this edge individually.
